market_note: Stablecoin market cap sits near $287-310B even as U.S. regulators missed the GENIUS Act's July 18 rule-finalization deadline, leaving issuers in limbo through August comment periods.

stablecoin_items.headline: GENIUS Act rules miss deadline, stablecoin uncertainty extends
stablecoin_items.summary: Treasury, OCC, Fed, FDIC and NCUA all missed the July 18 deadline to finalize implementing rules, leaving the $310B stablecoin market under an incomplete federal framework. Comment periods run into August (FDIC through Aug 4, five-agency CIP through Aug 21).

stablecoin_items.headline: Western Union launches stablecoin-linked Visa card
stablecoin_items.summary: Western Union and Rain unveiled Stablecard, pairing a USDPT stablecoin wallet with a Visa card so remittances arrive as stablecoins and spend instantly anywhere Visa is accepted.

stablecoin_items.headline: Standard Chartered-backed HKDAP stablecoin rollout slips to August
stablecoin_items.summary: Anchorpoint Financial pushed the public launch of its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HKDAP into August after missing Q2 and end-of-July targets, opting for a B2B2C distribution model via approved partners.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether's USDT stays locked out of the EU as Circle gains ground
stablecoin_items.summary: USDT remains without MiCA authorization and stays delisted from major EU-regulated exchanges, while Circle's USDC and EURC are MiCA-passportable across all EU member states via its French EMI license.

hack_items.headline: Coldcard hardware wallet exploit tops $130M
hack_items.summary: A five-year-old firmware flaw let attackers reconstruct Bitcoin seed keys, draining 1,800+ BTC across 5,200+ addresses since July 30 in multiple waves. Coinkite issued an emergency patch and urged anyone who generated a seed since March 2021 to migrate funds.

hack_items.headline: $35M drained in coordinated attacks on three protocols
hack_items.summary: AFX's Arbitrum bridge ($24.15M), the Verus-Ethereum bridge ($7.54M, its second hack this year) and B2's staking contract ($3.86M) were each hit within a six-hour window on July 22-23.

hack_items.headline: $290M Kelp DAO/LayerZero bridge hack sparked $9B Aave panic
hack_items.summary: The largest DeFi exploit of 2026 so far drained 116,500 rsETH from a LayerZero-built cross-chain bridge, triggering contagion fears that pushed investors to pull roughly $9B from Aave.

hack_items.headline: 2026 crypto hack losses near $1.2B across 276 incidents
hack_items.summary: CertiK's mid-year tally shows fewer but far more surgical hacks in 2026, with attackers increasingly targeting admin keys and off-chain infrastructure rather than smart contract code itself.
